readme.summary: **Keep code navigable** — audit architecture, do verified changes and explanation updates, and safely ship.

skills.audit: assess codebase shape (or read-only quick-check against a target spec)
skills.do: implement decided changes, refactor with behavior checks, or verify README, docs, and source headers against code
skills.ship: verify affected release docs, isolate and verify the release commit, then land it and safely clean up

blurb.en: Audit architecture, use Do for verified implementation, refactors and factual docs updates, then use Ship to check release docs and land the verified snapshot.
blurb.zh: audit 唯讀檢查架構，do 實作、重整並校對文件，ship 校對發布文件、驗證並送出這次的改動。

audit.en: ★ Assess codebase shape against the 8 rules — unconditional health, or read-only quick-check against a target spec. Read-only.
audit.zh: ★ 對照 8 規則評估 codebase 形狀 —— 無條件健康,或對應 spec 的唯讀快檢。唯讀。

do.en: Implement a decided change, preserve behavior in a refactor, or check and update reader docs and source headers. Use the relevant procedure on demand.
do.zh: 實作已定案的改動、維持行為的重整，或校對文件與檔頭。依任務讀取對應指引。

ship.en: Verify release docs and code from the same snapshot, preserve unrelated staged and working changes, then land and safely clean up. Review all docs when the user or project asks.
ship.zh: 用同一份發布程式校對文件及驗證行為，保留其他暫存與本機改動，再送出並安全清理。你或專案要求時，校對完整文件範圍。

desc.en: Audit architecture, use Do for verified implementation, refactors and factual docs updates, then use Ship to check release docs and land the verified snapshot.
desc.zh: audit 唯讀檢查架構，do 實作、重整並校對文件，ship 校對發布文件、驗證並送出這次的改動。

readme.summary: **Keep work resumable** — add ideas and tasks, view progress, advance work, and tend records.

skills.add: capture an idea, define planned work, or save progress into its original owner
skills.view: read current work, blockers and next actions without changing records
skills.next: advance ready, already-authorized work without reopening settled choices
skills.tend: configure the record home, register repos, explicitly migrate legacy work, and tidy records

blurb.en: Keep scope, verification and the next action together. Maintain the project connection and advance ready work.
blurb.zh: 把範圍、驗證和下一步留在原任務，維護專案接線並推進可做的工作。

tend.en: Set the working-record home, register a repository, explicitly migrate legacy records, or tidy existing work. Setup does not automatically move old data.
tend.zh: 設定工作紀錄的 home、登記專案、明確要求時遷移舊資料，或整理既有紀錄；接線不會自動搬資料。

next.en: Choose and advance the next ready, already-authorized task or exploration. Use when asked to continue or work while the user is away; a status-only request belongs to shape-view.
next.zh: 選出並推進已授權、現在能做的任務或探索。單純查進度用 shape-view。

add.en: Capture an idea, define pending work, or update the original record with progress. Use for add this, save this or wrap this round; viewing progress belongs to shape-view and execution to nav-do.
add.zh: 記下想法、建立待做工作，或把進度存回原紀錄。查看進度用 shape-view，實作交給 nav-do。

view.en: Read current project work, priorities, blockers and next actions without changing records. Use for status or catch me up; continuing implementation belongs to shape-next.
view.zh: 唯讀查看目前工作、優先順序、卡點與下一步。要接著實作用 shape-next。

desc.en: Add, View, Next and Tend keep ideas and authorized work resumable.
desc.zh: Add 記下、View 查看、Next 推進、Tend 整理。

readme.summary: **The understanding family** — help someone understand something. Two lenses to see a problem: `first-principles` (decompose down — strip to axioms, rebuild, surface divergence) and `orthogonal` (decompose sideways — factor a tangle into mutually-independent axes). Three forms to present an answer you already have: `analogize` (a checked analogy; also the ELI5 door), `draw` (the picture and its medium), `tinker` (an object to poke). One entry, `unfold`, walks a repository, paper, book, or concept through one layer per turn, choosing a form per layer. Lenses feed `shape` only when continuation is already authorized or the user asks; forms and entry don't. Renamed from `think`.

skills.first-principles: strip a question to its irreducible axioms, rebuild from them, and surface where that diverges from convention; analysis stays in-chat unless continuation was already authorized
skills.orthogonal: factor a tangled phenomenon into mutually-independent (orthogonal) axes; verify the independence (move one, the others stay put) and name what was conflated; in-chat
skills.analogize: on explicit request, build a checked analogy for a concept you already understand: compare candidates, verify the mapping against the real structure, pick on fit, and name where the winner breaks; in-chat
skills.draw: render something you already understand so it lands for someone else, with the form chosen by the kind of knowledge; terminal-first, escalating to an interactive artifact only when interaction changes visible state or the user asks. Distinct from `/seek:mockup`, which renders candidates so a decision can be picked — here the artifact is the explanation
skills.unfold: walk someone through an unfamiliar repository, library, paper, book, or concept by progressive disclosure: skeleton first, one layer per turn, each term glossed at first use, claims marked recorded/inferred/unknown, the learner's questions setting depth, a named checkpoint, and a form chosen per layer. Distinct from `/frame:analogize`, which gives a single explanation
skills.tinker: build a small interactive object to understand why something behaves as it does: one primary control, a visible before/after, details revealed as asked, persistent across turns, with an honest note where it simplifies. Output is an interactive HTML page handed over as a URL. Distinct from `/seek:mockup` (render to decide) and `/frame:draw` (choose a picture)

blurb.en: The understanding family: lenses to see a problem (first-principles strips assumptions and rebuilds; orthogonal factors independent axes), forms to present an answer already in hand (analogize builds a checked analogy and is the ELI5 door; draw chooses the picture and medium; tinker builds a small object to poke), and one entry (unfold walks a repository, paper, book, or concept one layer per turn, skeleton first, choosing a form per layer). unfold applies the forms by bundled protocol, never by calling a skill (ADR-010). ADR-010 still governs output: structure scales to the question. Analysis-only requests do not grant build authority. Standalone. Renamed from think; see frame/CLAUDE.md + ADR-010/009/012/006 + the rename ADR.
blurb.zh: 理解家族：lens 用來看清問題（first-principles 拆假設並重建；orthogonal 拆獨立軸）、form 用來呈現手上已有的答案（analogize 做檢查過的類比，也是 ELI5 的入口；draw 選圖形與媒介；tinker 做一個可以動手玩的小物件）、一個入口（unfold 用 progressive disclosure 帶你認識 repo、論文、書或概念：先骨架、一回合一層、每層選一種形式）。unfold 以內附協議套用各 form，不呼叫其他 skill（ADR-010）。輸出仍依 ADR-010 隨問題大小調整；只要求分析不授權 build。獨立。由 think 改名；見 frame/CLAUDE.md + ADR-010/009/012/006 + 改名 ADR。

first-principles.en: Reason a question from first principles — name the conventional answer + inherited assumptions, strip to irreducible base facts, rebuild from those alone, and surface the divergence from convention. The reasoning check remains; the visible worksheet/headings scale to the question. Plain language is the style, not a zero-jargon ban: use technical terms when useful and gloss them when needed. Analysis-only stays in chat unless continuation was already authorized. ADR-010/009.
first-principles.zh: 從第一性原理推一個問題 —— 講出慣例答案 + 它繼承的假設,剝到不可再分的基礎事實,只用這些重建答案,再標出它跟慣例的分歧。reasoning check 保留;可見 worksheet/headings 按問題大小調整。白話是風格,不是零術語禁令:技術詞有用就用,需要時補 gloss。只要求分析就留在對話內,除非已授權接續。ADR-010/009。

orthogonal.en: Factor a tangled phenomenon into mutually independent axes, verify the independence (move one; the others should not move), and name what was conflated or falsely decoupled. The independence check remains; tables or diagrams appear only when they help. Technical words such as orthogonal/axis are allowed with a useful gloss. In-chat unless continuation was already authorized. ADR-010.
orthogonal.zh: 把一個糾結的現象拆成互相獨立的軸,驗證獨立性(動一個,其他不該跟著動),並點出被混為一談或假性分開的東西。獨立性檢查保留;table 或 diagram 只有有幫助才出現。orthogonal/axis 這類技術詞可用,需要時補 gloss。除非已授權接續,否則留在對話內。ADR-010。

analogize.en: Explain an understood concept with a structurally checked analogy. Compare alternatives privately, deliver only the useful mapping and relevant limitations. Presentation scales to the question; no fixed four-part output. The analogy is requested, not an automatic addition to other skills. ADR-010.
analogize.zh: 用檢查過結構對應的比喻解釋已理解的概念。先比較候選，再交付有用的對應與必要限制；依問題大小決定長度，不強制四段格式。比喻是這個 skill 的明確任務，不是其他 skill 每次都要加上的結尾。ADR-010。

draw.en: Render something already understood so it lands for someone else — the form chosen by the KIND of knowledge, never by habit: ownership → spatial map (positions permanent) · temporal process → run playback · state over time → time stepper (a table can state a lifetime; only a stepper shows one expiring) · delta from what they know → claim expansion (their own sentences, verdict as the door, mechanism/trade-off/cost behind it) · taxonomy → grouped map · structure → weighted node-edge graph with next-step hints · lifecycle → canonical-run diagram. Terminal-first; escalate to an interactive artifact only when interaction changes visible state or the audience asks — 'it would look nicer' is not a threshold. Sibling of analogize: same outward direction, picture instead of comparison. NOT /seek:mockup, which renders candidates so a decision can be picked.
draw.zh: 把一個你已經懂的東西畫出來,讓別人也懂——形式由「知識的種類」決定,不由習慣決定:擁有權 → 空間圖(位置固定不動)· 時間流程 → 執行播放 · 狀態隨時間變化 → 時間步進器(表格講得出壽命,只有步進器看得到東西消失)· 與對方已知的差 → 主張展開(用他自己的句子,判定當入口,機制/取捨/代價在後面)· 分類 → 分組圖 · 結構 → 帶路標的加權 graph · 生命週期 → canonical-run 圖。預設終端機圖;只有「互動會改變可見狀態」或對方明說要,才升級成互動 artifact——「這樣比較好看」不算門檻。analogize 的手足:同樣朝外交付,只是換成圖而非類比。NOT /seek:mockup——那是 render 候選讓你「挑」,這裡 artifact 本身就是解釋。

unfold.en: Walk someone through an unfamiliar repository, library, paper, book, or concept one layer at a time. Skeleton first; one layer per turn; each new term glossed at first use; key claims anchored and marked recorded, inferred, or unknown; the learner's questions set route and depth; each turn ends at a checkpoint naming what is open. Per layer it picks a form (plain text, analogy, picture, object to poke), names it in a short phrase, and honors overrides. No fixed level count, gates, or learner-state file. NOT a single explanation or ELI5: that is /frame:analogize. ADR-010.
unfold.zh: 一層一層帶人認識不熟的 repo、library、論文、書或概念。先給骨架；一回合只講一層；每個新詞第一次出現就補一句 gloss；重要主張標出處並區分「來源記載／我的推論／未知」；學習者的問題決定路線與深度；每回合停在說明還有什麼沒解的 checkpoint。每一層自己選形式（純文字、類比、圖、可操作的物件）、用一個短語說出來、並接受隨時覆寫。沒有固定層數、關卡或學習者狀態檔。NOT 單次解釋或 ELI5——那是 /frame:analogize。ADR-010。

tinker.en: Build a small interactive object the learner can poke to understand why something behaves as it does: one primary control, a visible before/after, details revealed as asked, the same object extended across turns, and a visible note where it simplifies the source. Output is one interactive HTML page, activated and handed over as a URL. NOT /seek:mockup (render candidates to decide) or /frame:draw (choose a picture). ADR-010.
tinker.zh: 做一個可以動手玩的小物件，讓人理解某件事為什麼會這樣運作：一個主要控制項、看得見的前後差異、細節等被問到才展開、後續問題在同一個物件上延伸，並明講它在哪裡簡化了來源。輸出是一個互動 HTML 頁面，啟動後給可點的 URL。NOT /seek:mockup（render 候選來做決定）或 /frame:draw（選一張圖）。ADR-010。

desc.en: Understanding family: first-principles and orthogonal see a problem; analogize, draw, and tinker present an answer; unfold walks a subject one layer per turn and applies the forms by bundled protocol. Reasoning checks remain, but output scales to the question. Analysis alone grants no build authority; ADR-010.
desc.zh: 理解家族：first-principles 與 orthogonal 看清問題；analogize、draw、tinker 呈現答案；unfold 一回合一層地帶人走過一個主題，並以內附協議套用各 form。保留實質檢查，呈現隨問題大小調整。單純分析不授權實作；ADR-010、ADR-010。

readme.summary: **Find an answer** — clarify, compare, measure and try real workflows with lightweight methods.

skills.elicit: clarify the consequential choice or cause
skills.mockup: build an operable comparison and verify its interaction
skills.probe: test a claim or interpret existing measurements
skills.dogfood: use a real feature and report reproducible friction

blurb.en: Choose a method for the question. Keep results in chat or scratch until retention has a purpose.
blurb.zh: 依問題選方法，結果先留在對話或暫存，需要保留時才存。

elicit.en: Clarify an unsettled choice or specific cause through grounded conversation. Use for help me think this through; measurable claims belong to seek-probe and interactive comparisons to seek-mockup.
elicit.zh: 用接地的對話釐清尚未決定的選擇或具體原因。可測量的主張交給 seek-probe，需要操作比較則用 seek-mockup。

mockup.en: Build an interactive comparison when the user wants to see or try alternatives before choosing. Use for mockups and behavior comparisons; implementation and persistent records require their own scope.
mockup.zh: 把選項做成可操作的比較，讓使用者看過、試過再決定。是否實作或保存，依照各自的授權範圍。

probe.en: Test a measurable claim or assess existing measurements. Use for experiments and ablations; preferences belong to seek-mockup and built-feature usage to seek-dogfood.
probe.zh: 以實驗檢驗可測量的主張，或判讀既有測量。偏好比較用 seek-mockup，實際使用已完成的功能用 seek-dogfood。

dogfood.en: Use a built feature through its real interface to find reproducible friction and missing user paths. Use for try it or dogfood; testing an undecided claim belongs to seek-probe.
dogfood.zh: 透過真實介面使用已完成的功能，找出可重現的阻礙與缺少的操作路徑。未定主張的實驗交給 seek-probe。

desc.en: Elicit, Mockup, Probe and Dogfood are independent, lightweight methods.
desc.zh: Elicit、Mockup、Probe、Dogfood 是可獨立使用的精簡方法。
